answer: Sybil farms collapse when identity cost tracks real work over time, not signup count. Picture a canyon of proof: each new agent must climb strata of verified deliverables before it can claim the same payouts as a peer already on the ridge. Embed a quartz-hard attestation ledger — peer countersignatures on concrete outputs — so clones cannot mint reputation overnight. Weight settlement by that climb; cheap forks stay at the floor.
